- Build a complete, playable Warcraft III-styled hero tower defense game with at least 100 levels.

## Requirements
- Deliver a playable game now without asking clarifying questions.
- User requested JPEG screenshots for checks, viewport no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- Implemented a standalone browser game in one HTML file, with a fantasy campaign theme, canvas-rendered battlefield, tower placement, hero abilities, and autosaving progress.

## Work State

### Completed
- Added a playable 100-wave campaign with four tower types, tower upgrades, hero leveling and abilities, enemy waves and bosses, speed controls, auto-wave mode, save progress, and mobile-responsive layout.
- Checked JavaScript syntax and browser console; exercised tower placement and wave progression.
- Captured and inspected desktop and mobile JPEG screenshots.

- (none)

1. If further changes are requested, continue from `index.html`; current implementation is uncommitted.

- `index.html`: Complete standalone game implementation.

content.text:
Built **Ironwood Keep**, a playable Warcraft III-inspired hero tower defense campaign in `index.html`.

It includes 100 waves, four tower types with upgrades, a leveling hero with two abilities, boss waves, speed controls, auto-wave mode, and autosaved progress. The game is standalone and mobile-responsive.

Verified tower placement and wave progression in-browser, checked desktop and mobile layouts, and found no JavaScript console errors. JPEG checks: `/tmp/opencode/ironwood-check.jpg` and `/tmp/opencode/ironwood-mobile.jpg`.
